blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) on Monday, Oct. 19, stood in defense of the members of the Defense Press Corps and all Filipino media workers covering Philippine-China relations and the West Philippine Sea. “We remind the [Chinese] embassy to respect the rigor, professionalism, and ethical standards with which Filipino journalists carry out their work,” it said in a statement that took exception to the embassy’s remarks questioning Filipino reporters’ understanding of facts. Over the weekend, the Chinese embassy in Manila accused Filipino journalists and politicians of distorting facts and exaggerating tensions with Beijing, as […]...
